page_title: ALA 2-1 SEV | Alaves v Sevilla 20/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Javier Alberola Rojas shows the yellow card to Kike Salas (Sevilla) for a heavy challenge.
90+4' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
90+2' None of the Sevilla players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' That's the end of the game for Joan Jordan, who is replaced by Santiago Mourino (Alaves).
87' Yellow card. Jon Guridi (Alaves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
86' Loic Bade (Sevilla) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul.
86' Kike Garcia (Alaves) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

83' 2 - 1 GOAL 2:1! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
82' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
78' The attendance for today's match is 16538.
77' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Joan Jordan (Alaves). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
77' Substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) in, Carlos Martin out.
76' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kike Garcia (Alaves) replacing Toni Martinez.
75' Loic Bade (Sevilla) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
73' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and signals a foul after Carlos Martin (Alaves) brought his opponent down.
72' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
71' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Ander Guevara is replaced by Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
71' It is time for a substitution. Jon Guridi (Alaves) is on for Stoichkov.
70' The substitution is prepared. Nemanja Gudelj joins the action as a substitute, replacing Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
70' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Loic Bade (Sevilla) replaces Tanguy Nianzou.
66' Toni Martinez (Alaves) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Valentin Barco (Sevilla) is replacing Adria Pedrosa.
66' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Lucien Agoume will be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
64' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
63' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
62' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

60' 2 - 0 The ball finds its way to Carlos Martin (Alaves) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 2:0.
60' Stoichkov (Alaves) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!

60' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
58' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement.
56' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul after Abdel Abqar (Alaves) hacks down one of his opponents.
51' A clumsy foul by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle.
50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
49' Toni Martinez (Alaves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
48' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Sevilla take a short corner kick.
45+3' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Sevilla win a corner.
45+1' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+1' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola Rojas signals a set piece.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
41' Sevilla are ruled offside.
37' Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola Rojas saw the whole situation.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' What was Saul Niguez (Sevilla) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

32' Joan Jordan (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
28' Referee Javier Alberola Rojas sees the trip by Abdel Abqar (Alaves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
25' Celebrations are cut short for Alaves as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
25' Wait! Referee Javier Alberola Rojas has indicated he is going to review the Alaves goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
23' Stoichkov (Alaves) converts a killer cross with a strong and precise shot that goes across the goal and past the goalkeeper.
21' Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
17' 1 - 0 Carlos Vicente (Alaves) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
15' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) brings his opponent down. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Isaac Romero doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
14' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
12' The injury to Isaac Romero (Sevilla) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
9' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
9' Peque (Sevilla) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
8' A player from Alaves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Javier Alberola Rojas couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Javier Alberola Rojas was nominated as the referee for this game.
